speaker: Ms Foo Mee Har
text: asked	the Minister for Manpower in light of job layoffs hitting a seven-year high (a) how successful have current support schemes been in helping Singaporeans, particularly PMEs, secure new jobs; and (b) what additional measures will the Government implement should the unemployment situation deteriorate further.

speaker: The Minister for Manpower (Mr Lim Swee Say)
text: The Workforce Development Agency (WDA) and the Employment and Employability Institute (e2i) have also ramped up the number of job fairs and other career support events, such as career workshops and learning journeys, to hiring firms.

speaker: The Minister for Manpower (Mr Lim Swee Say)
text: Ms Foo Mee Har asked how effective our current support schemes are.

speaker: The Minister for Manpower (Mr Lim Swee Say)
text: Ms Foo also asked what additional measures we	will implement moving forward.

speaker: The Minister for Manpower (Mr Lim Swee Say)
text: This is to maximise matching between the aspiration of workers and the manpower needs of businesses.

speaker: The Minister for Manpower (Mr Lim Swee Say)
text: We believe this is the best way to position Singapore for growth and to create better jobs for our people.

speaker: The Minister for Manpower (Mr Lim Swee Say)
text: Later on, we will be doing the Second Reading of the WSG Bill and I will be happy to elaborate further.

speaker: Mdm Speaker
text: Mr Low, we have already past that question.

speaker: Mr Low Thia Khiang
text: I should have been allowed to ask more supplementary questions.

speaker: Mdm Speaker
text: You should have put your hand up very quickly, Mr Low.

speaker: Mdm Speaker
text: Unfortunately, I have already called the next question.

speaker: Mdm Speaker
text: Ms Foo, make it very short and snappy.

speaker: Mr Lim Swee Say
text: In fact, the list of companies is growing.

speaker: Mr Lim Swee Say
text: If Members are interested, feel free to file a PQ.

speaker: Mdm Speaker
text: [Pursuant to Standing Order No 22(3), provided that Members had not asked for questions standing in their names to be postponed to a later Sitting day or withdrawn, written answers to questions not reached by the end of Question Time are reproduced in the Appendix.]
